assets.pose: FALLING THROUGH THE AIR, genuinely surprised. Robot has lost balance and is dropping feet-first: both arms flung upward and slightly apart above shoulder level as if weightless, elbows bent and hands open; short legs hanging unevenly with knees slightly bent, toes tipping down. Torso slightly arched, head tilting just 10 degrees. Eyes wide tall white ovals, small round white O mouth, clearly surprised rather than smiling. The whole robot is airborne, no ground shadow. Playful cartoon mishap, not frightened or hurt. Full silhouette legible.
